buxton_h4_0.text: My mum runs a stall in the Pavilion Gardens. They were laid out by Edward Milner, who also did Crystal Palace Park.
Mum says the ducks run the place. I say the ducks run Mum.

buxton_h4_1.text: A 'twitchel' is our word for a narrow alley. Buxton is full of them, and every one has a shortcut and a cat.
